features.description: Agent can check local Claude CLI availability
steps: Run init check
Verify command -v claude succeeds or reports actionable error
Verify claude --version is captured when available
features.evidence: Claude CLI 2.1.162 detected and available via subprocess

features.description: Text input mode can invoke Claude CLI
steps: Run voice-claude-agent demo-text '请回复 OK'
Verify claude -p is invoked via subprocess
Verify exit code is captured
features.evidence: demo-text '请回复 OK' -> Claude CLI returned 'OK', exit_code=0, summary and TTS output captured

features.description: Claude CLI stdout/stderr/exit code is fully recorded
steps: Execute a Claude CLI command that produces output
Verify stdout is captured in ClaudeRunResult
Verify stderr is captured in ClaudeRunResult
Verify exit code is captured in ClaudeRunResult
Verify timed_out flag is set correctly
features.evidence: 4 test_claude_runner tests pass: success, file_not_found, timeout, dataclass_fields all verified

features.description: A structured summary is generated after each execution
steps: Run claude_runner with a known prompt
Pass result to summarizer
Verify summary is non-empty string
Verify summary mentions exit code or status
features.evidence: 5 summarizer tests pass: success, failure, timeout, claude_not_found, empty output — all return descriptive summaries

features.description: TTS can speak the summary; MVP uses macOS say
steps: Create MacOSSaySpeaker
Call speak('test message')
Verify no exception raised
Create FakeSpeaker for tests
Verify FakeSpeaker records spoken text
features.evidence: 3 TTS tests pass: MacOSSaySpeaker no-raise, FakeSpeaker records text, FakeSpeaker starts empty

features.description: High-risk actions trigger confirmation flow
steps: Classify a prompt containing 'push' as external_or_destructive
Classify a prompt containing 'read file' as read_only
Verify requires_confirmation returns True for destructive
Verify requires_confirmation returns False for read_only
features.evidence: 8 risk classifier tests pass: read_only, recoverable, destructive keywords all classified correctly

features.description: Unconfirmed push/delete/deploy actions are rejected
steps: Call confirm_or_reject with destructive risk and rejection
Verify returns (False, reason)
Call confirm_or_reject with read_only risk
Verify returns (True, reason) — no confirmation needed
features.evidence: 3 confirmation tests pass: read_only auto-approves, destructive rejected, destructive confirmed

features.description: Task logs are written to agent_state/sessions.jsonl
steps: Write a session entry
Verify sessions.jsonl exists and contains one valid JSON line
Verify required fields are present
features.evidence: 3 logging tests pass: single session write, last_result write, multiple session append — all JSONL valid

features.description: Failed executions are reported with cause and suggestions
steps: Summarize a result with exit_code != 0
Verify summary mentions failure or exit code
Summarize a timed-out result
Verify summary mentions timeout
features.evidence: Summarizer tests cover exit_code=1, exit_code=-1 (timeout), exit_code=-2 (not found) — all generate descriptive Chinese summaries

features.description: Voice input interface exists; mock if real STT unavailable
steps: Verify STT interface protocol is defined (stt.py)
Verify mock transcriber is available for testing
features.evidence: Phase 2: stt.py enhanced with RecordingTranscriber (text-input + whisper-cli backends), recorder.py with real SoundDeviceRecorder + FakeRecorder. CLI: record, voice, demo-voice commands.

features.description: Wake trigger interface exists; shortcut/CLI if real wake word unavailable
steps: Verify wake trigger interface is defined (wake.py)
Verify manual/CLI trigger is available as alternative
features.evidence: wake.py created with WakeTrigger protocol and ManualWakeTrigger (Enter key / programmatic trigger)

features.description: Full demo-text pipeline is testable end-to-end
steps: Run ./init.sh test
Verify integration test covers demo-text flow
Verify tests pass without real Claude CLI dependency
features.evidence: 28/28 tests pass (1.44s). Integration tests: test_pipeline_with_mocked_claude + test_destructive_pipeline_is_blocked both pass

features.description: Real microphone recording is available via sounddevice
steps: Verify SoundDeviceRecorder can be imported and instantiated
Verify start/stop/get_audio lifecycle works
Verify FakeRecorder mimics the same interface for tests
features.evidence: 3 recorder tests pass: FakeRecorder lifecycle, call counting, empty default. SoundDeviceRecorder importable and tested manually via 'voice-claude-agent record'.

features.description: demo-voice CLI command pipes STT transcript to Claude (not CLI arg)
steps: Run demo-voice with a CLI argument
Verify Claude receives the STT transcript, not the raw CLI argument
Verify CLI-level test confirms STT output reaches Claude
features.evidence: 2 CLI tests pass: test_demo_voice_uses_transcript_not_stub (CLI arg ignored), test_demo_voice_stt_output_reaches_claude (STT output reaches Claude)

features.description: voice command runs the full record -> STT -> Claude -> TTS pipeline
steps: Run voice --fake to exercise the pipeline without real mic
Verify recorded audio is transcribed
Verify transcript is passed to Claude CLI
Verify summary is spoken via TTS
features.evidence: TestVoicePipeline passes: FakeRecorder → FakeTranscriber → run_claude → summarizer → FakeSpeaker verified end-to-end. voice --fake exercises real CLI path.

features.description: Wake loop runs: trigger → record → STT → Claude → TTS, looping until Ctrl+C
steps: Run voice-claude-agent wake --fake --once
Verify the loop runs one iteration and exits
Verify wake trigger activates, recorder runs, STT produces transcript, Claude executes, TTS speaks
features.evidence: 3 wake loop tests pass: --fake --once runs one iteration and logs voice session; Ctrl+C clean exit; ManualWakeTrigger auto_trigger returns True and counts correctly

features.description: ManualWakeTrigger integrates with the wake command for push-to-talk semantics
steps: Verify ManualWakeTrigger.wait_for_wake() returns True on auto_trigger
Verify wake loop respects Ctrl+C (KeyboardInterrupt)
Verify each iteration records fresh audio and transcribes independently
features.evidence: test_manual_wake_trigger_auto_trigger: 2x wait_for_wake both return True, trigger_count increments. test_wake_fake_loop_ctrl_c: KeyboardInterrupt causes clean exit.

features.description: Wake command is testable via CLI with fake components
steps: Run wake --fake --once via CliRunner
Verify the CLI exits cleanly with exit code 0
Verify session log is written with input_mode=voice
features.evidence: test_wake_fake_once_runs_one_iteration: CliRunner exit_code=0, sessions.jsonl has input_mode=voice, transcript='请回复 OK'. Also verified via real CLI: wake --fake --once.

features.description: check command reports microphone permission status
steps: Run voice-claude-agent check
Verify microphone line shows ACCESSIBLE or DENIED / UNAVAILABLE
Verify check does not exit with error when mic is denied
features.evidence: check command shows 'Microphone: ACCESSIBLE (microphone accessible)'. STT backends listed: text-input, whisper-cli, apple-speech. Does not exit 1 when mic unavailable.

features.description: RecordingTranscriber supports apple-speech backend on macOS
steps: Check apple-speech appears in list_available_backends() on macOS
Call RecordingTranscriber(backend='apple-speech').transcribe(bytes)
Verify it returns an Apple Speech status message (not a crash)
features.evidence: list_available_backends() includes apple-speech on Darwin. test_recording_transcriber_apple_speech_returns_status: returns Dictation status message without crash.

features.description: Real recording failures show clear user-facing error messages
steps: Run voice or wake without --fake when mic is denied
Verify a yellow WARNING or red error message is printed
Verify the message mentions System Settings > Privacy & Security > Microphone
features.evidence: test__warn_mic_prints_warning: WARNING + Microphone + System Settings all in output. test__safe_real_recorder_returns_none: returns None on PortAudio error with red error message. voice/wake/record all gate on _safe_real_recorder before recording.

features.description: Project can be installed as an editable package via ./init.sh install
steps: Run ./init.sh install in a clean venv
Verify voice-claude-agent entry point is registered
Verify voice_claude_agent package is importable
Verify all dependencies (click, sounddevice, numpy, pytest, ruff) resolve
features.evidence: ./init.sh install: editable install succeeds (uv-based, 12 packages resolved). voice-claude-agent entry point registered — --help lists 7 commands. voice_claude_agent importable. Dependencies: click 8.4.1, sounddevice 0.5.5, numpy 2.4.6, pytest 9.0.3, ruff 0.15.16. 55/55 tests, lint clean.

features.description: voice-claude-agent --help lists all available commands
steps: Run voice-claude-agent --help
Verify check, demo-text, run-text, record, voice, demo-voice, wake are listed

features.description: wake loop prints per-iteration status: waiting, woke, recording, transcript, summary
steps: Run voice-claude-agent wake --fake --once
Verify [1] Waiting for wake trigger... appears
Verify [1] Woke! Recording... appears
Verify [1] Transcript: ... appears
Verify Summary line appears before exit

features.description: wake loop handles empty/broken audio without crashing
steps: Simulate recorder returning empty audio bytes
Verify wake prints No audio captured and continues to next iteration
Simulate STT returning empty transcript
Verify wake prints No speech detected and continues to next iteration

features.description: wake loop handles STT backend errors without crashing
steps: Simulate STT returning [STT error: ...] prefix
Verify wake prints yellow warning about STT error
Verify wake skips Claude execution and continues to next iteration

features.description: Claude CLI timeout is handled gracefully in the pipeline
steps: Simulate Claude CLI exceeding timeout
Verify _run_pipeline logs a session with summary='Timed out'
Verify TTS speaks a timeout message

features.description: Real recording start/stop errors are caught and reported
steps: Simulate recorder.start() raising an exception
Verify Recording start failed error is printed in red
Verify wake loop continues to next iteration instead of crashing

features.description: whisper-cli backend produces a real transcription when whisper.cpp is installed
steps: Install whisper.cpp (brew install whisper-cpp)
Record a short speech sample
Run voice --stt-backend whisper-cli
Verify transcript is actual speech text, not an error message or audio stats

features.description: apple-speech backend detects dictation on/off and returns appropriate status
steps: Run check: verify apple-speech is listed as available on macOS
Call RecordingTranscriber(backend='apple-speech').transcribe(...)
If dictation is OFF: verify prompt to enable it in System Settings
If dictation is ON: verify audio is played for dictation (non-crashing)

features.description: README covers STT backends, fake/real modes, and Apple Speech limitations
steps: Read README.md
Verify --stt-backend option is documented for voice, record, wake
Verify table explains text-input, whisper-cli, apple-speech
Verify Apple Speech section explains the 'text appears in active field' limitation
Verify fake/real mode table is present
